body: heimq v0.1.2 (dcbbff1) vendored the bounded kafka-protocol as heimq-protocol. fjord latest (telepathdata/fjord v0.1.2 / 43d7071) still declares kafka-protocol='0.15' directly (fjord-broker + fjord-heimq-backend, incl. use kafka_protocol:: in src) and pins pre-vendoring heimq cd17c186, so upstream kafka-protocol cannot be removed from pqueue until fjord ships a heimq-protocol release. User is publishing the fjord update. Resume pqueue migration when the fjord tag is available. Meanwhile pqueue keeps the 0.15.1 bounded fork via [patch] + the negative-verified regression guard (DoS closed); P0 pqueue-301c32cc stays open on the paste clause only.
summary: blocked on a fjord release adopting heimq-protocol (heimq v0.1.2 already vendored it)

body:
All 5 acceptance criteria MET:
1. `grep 'name = "kafka-protocol"' Cargo.lock` -> 0 matches (upstream kafka-protocol fully gone).
2. No upstream kafka-protocol dependency anywhere in crates/ or Cargo.toml — heimq-protocol only
   (crates/pqueue-server/Cargo.toml dep + change_record_sink.rs imports heimq_protocol::*).
3. `cargo deny check` PASSES: advisories ok, bans ok, licenses ok, sources ok (paste RUSTSEC-2024-0436
   documented-ignored with rationale, commit fac76f81).
4. `cargo test -p pqueue-server` passes incl. the renamed/rewritten bound guard
   (heimq_protocol_bound_guard.rs, 2 passed; negative-verified). Record-batch decode remains bounded
   via heimq-protocol.
5. `cargo test --workspace` passes, 0 failed.
Migration commits: a002038a (heimq-protocol swap + [patch] removal + guard), 541e230a (fjord v0.1.3
finalized 4a1d5629), fac76f81 (paste ignore). fjord/heimq upstream changes were the non-scope
precondition and have shipped (fjord v0.1.3 adopts heimq-protocol; heimq v0.1.2 vendored it).
summary: Upstream kafka-protocol removed; heimq-protocol vendored; cargo deny fully green; all 5 ACs met
